audit_items.proof_trace: The assertion 'cancel() succeeds => msg.sender ∈ {projectAdmin ∪ legionOperators}' is logically satisfied — only projectAdmin can succeed, which is a subset of the allowed set. However, spec invariant INV-002 (SG-009) explicitly states 'Either projectAdmin or Legion operator can cancel,' and the protocol uses onlyLegionOrProject for end() but only onlyProject for cancel(). Legion operator cannot cancel a sale even when a project admin is unresponsive or adversarial, and no equivalent emergency-cancel path enables the investor refund flow (pause/emergencyWithdraw do not set isCanceled).
audit_items.attack_scenario: A project admin of a failed or fraudulent sale refuses to call cancel(); investors cannot reclaim capital via withdrawInvestedCapitalIfCanceled, and Legion can only pause or emergencyWithdraw (neither triggers the cancel refund path), leaving investor funds effectively locked.
